name: f02-conditional-instruction
description: SYNTHETIC. One utterance carrying a time, an instruction, a condition, and two further actions that apply only if the condition holds. The shape product.md §11.2 gives as the case worth restructuring.

turns.speaker: partner
turns.text: 朝ごはんのあとに薬を飲んでください。もしふらつくようでしたら、その日は飲むのをやめて、こちらに電話してください。

expect.notes: Dropping the condition leaves an instruction to take medicine unconditionally. That is an over-reduction failure, not a stylistic one.
